scope: Selected sourced MEDR5 Angelman pilot; no disease expansion.

sources.extracted_claim: Loss of maternal UBE3A activity in neurons is central to Angelman syndrome. Developmental delay, severe speech impairment, ataxia and seizures are characteristic. Large deletions may involve additional genes.
sources.uncertainty: Source-specific context; no systematic contradiction review or independent clinical validation.
sources.study_design: Authoritative overview/navigation; not a candidate intervention experiment.

sources.source: Huang et al.: Topoisomerase inhibitors unsilence the dormant allele of Ube3a in neurons
sources.extracted_claim: Topotecan restored paternal Ube3a expression in neuronal models by reducing an antisense transcript. This is experimental unsilencing evidence, not clinical efficacy.
sources.uncertainty: Preclinical/cellular context. Replicate counts depend on assay; no clinical efficacy or safety established by these experiments.
sources.title: Topoisomerase inhibitors unsilence the dormant allele of Ube3a in neurons.
sources.study_design: Small-molecule screening and experimental neuronal/mouse unsilencing assays.

sample_size.reported: Figure 2a: n=4 per dose-response point; 2h: n=4–5 cultures per point. Assay-level counts, not patients or a study-wide N.

sources.source: Meng et al.: Towards a therapy for Angelman syndrome by targeting a long non-coding RNA
sources.extracted_claim: UBE3A-ATS antisense perturbations restored paternal UBE3A in mouse models. The authors compared selective antisense effects with topotecan effects on long-gene transcription; phenotypic rescue was incomplete.
sources.uncertainty: Preclinical/cellular context. Replicate counts depend on assay; no clinical efficacy or safety established by these experiments.
sources.title: Towards a therapy for Angelman syndrome by targeting a long non-coding RNA.
sources.study_design: Experimental antisense perturbations in neuronal and mouse models; expression and phenotype readouts.

sample_size.reported: Extended Data Figure 1b: n=2 per group for the nascent-transcript assay. Other assays have different counts; not a study-wide N.

sources.source: King et al.: Topoisomerases facilitate transcription of long genes linked to autism
sources.extracted_claim: Topotecan reduced transcription of long neuronal genes in mouse and human models. This broad transcriptional effect is a spillover concern when probing UBE3A unsilencing.
sources.uncertainty: Preclinical/cellular context. Replicate counts depend on assay; no clinical efficacy or safety established by these experiments.
sources.title: Topoisomerases facilitate transcription of long genes linked to autism.
sources.study_design: Experimental TOP1 perturbation with neuronal transcriptomics and knockdown controls.

sample_size.reported: Figure 1: n=5 mouse neuronal biological replicates; n=2 human iPSC-neuron biological replicates. Not patients.

sources.source: Fink et al.: Disrupted neuronal maturation in Angelman syndrome-derived induced pluripotent stem cells
sources.extracted_claim: Topotecan increased UBE3A expression and improved selected electrophysiological readouts in Angelman-derived neuronal cultures. This is cellular evidence, not a patient treatment result.
sources.uncertainty: Preclinical/cellular context. Replicate counts depend on assay; no clinical efficacy or safety established by these experiments.
sources.title: Disrupted neuronal maturation in Angelman syndrome-derived induced pluripotent stem cells.
sources.study_design: Human iPSC-derived neuronal experiments with unaffected controls, UBE3A perturbations and cellular rescue readouts.

sample_size.reported: 3 Angelman donors and 4 unrelated control donors. Figure 2c topotecan RMP assay: 2–4 coverslips per condition, 15 cells per coverslip. Cells/coverslips are not independent patient counts.

sources.extracted_claim: Oncology labeling warns of severe myelosuppression and identifies renal impairment as relevant to exposure. It supplies no validated organ-burden number for Angelman research.
sources.uncertainty: Source-specific context; no systematic contradiction review or independent clinical validation.
sources.study_design: Regulatory drug label; oncology indications and warnings.

sources.title: Angelman syndrome — MONDO
sources.extracted_claim: MONDO term MONDO:0007113 is labelled Angelman syndrome. Terminology identity does not establish a drug effect or disease association.
sources.uncertainty: Record scope applies; no efficacy, safety, partnership or guaranteed asset access implied.
sources.study_design: Curated ontology term / identifier mapping, not clinical or experimental evidence.

sources.source: ClinVar UBE3A deletion / Angelman condition record
sources.title: ClinVar UBE3A deletion / Angelman condition record
sources.extracted_claim: ClinVar lists this UBE3A deletion with a Pathogenic Angelman-specific condition classification. Broader variant aggregation is Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic. This is a database assertion, not a measured rescue effect, patient diagnosis or treatment response.
sources.uncertainty: Check transcript, parent of origin, genotype and functional evidence. ClinVar pathogenicity is not automatically a gain/loss direction or treatment-fit score.
sources.review_status: criteria provided, multiple submitters, no conflicts
sources.study_design: Submitted germline variant classifications; multiple submitters, no conflicts, not expert-panel review.

profiles.scope: Disease-level UBE3A-deficiency research model only. Not a genotype-specific treatment match or all deletion-associated biology.
assumptions: Maternal neuronal UBE3A deficiency is the modeled deviation.
Functional paternal UBE3A is present and its unsilencing is biologically relevant; this is not verified for an individual.

targets.label: UBE3A
targets.context: Loss of maternal neuronal UBE3A activity; desired increase of functional expression.

unresolved: Human neuronal functional rescue beyond measured cellular readouts
Broader deletion-associated biology is outside the modeled axis

interventions.name: Topotecan
interventions.summary: Existing oncology drug with experimental paternal UBE3A unsilencing. A cellular research hypothesis; no established Angelman efficacy.

effects.label: UBE3A
effects.context: Indirect paternal unsilencing, not direct UBE3A agonism; experimental neuronal context, not direct protein binding or agonism.

spillover.label: Long-gene transcription
spillover.context: Reduced long-gene transcription in experimental neurons; one correlated mechanism, not an invented count of affected genes.

warnings.label: Severe myelosuppression warning in oncology label
Renal impairment affects labeled exposure/dosing; no dose advice here

interventions.name: UBE3A-ATS antisense perturbation
interventions.summary: Experimental comparator to probe selective unsilencing. Mouse-model ASOs in this paper are not assumed equivalent to ION582.

effects.label: UBE3A
effects.context: Paternal expression via targeted antisense transcript reduction; experimental neuronal context, not direct protein binding or agonism.

variant_examples.scope: Public record identifier; pathogenicity is not functional direction or rescue evidence.
